verified_existing.comment: Hero 'Bookings' OK conceptuellement. MAIS valeur 26.2 obsolete. FY25 reel: Backlog 'currently stands at EUR 38.8 Mds' (CEO message). Remaining Performance Obligations EUR 46.5 Mds fin 2025 (vs 43.3 fin 2024). ASML ne report plus 'net bookings' trimestriels publiquement de la meme facon - utilise Backlog comme KPI canonique. PV 10. A refresh.
verified_existing.hero_kpi_should_be: Backlog (EUR 38.8 Mds) ou Net System Sales (EUR 24.5 Mds)

verified_existing.comment: FY25 GM = 52.8% (FY24: 51.3%, +1.5 ppt). CORRECT. Driver = NXE product mix + S&FO margins.

FY25 Income from Operations = EUR 11.301 Mds / EUR 32.667 Mds Net Sales = 34.6%. Stocke 44.3% INCORRECT (probablement confusion avec autre metrique - peut-etre 'system gross margin contribution'). Vrai op margin FY25 = 34.6% (FY24: 31.9%). A corriger.
FY25 R&D = EUR 4,698.8M = 14.4% of net sales (FY24: 15.2%). Stocke 15.1% est entre les deux - probablement annee fiscale anterieure (FY23: 16.5%). A refresh a 14.4%.
FY25 purchase of property/plant/equipment = EUR 1.574 Mds (+ intangibles EUR 58M = EUR 1.632 Mds total). FY24: EUR 2.067 Mds. Stocke 1.8 trop eleve - capex en BAISSE FY25 apres pic FY24.
FY25 Total employees > 44,000 FTEs (page 'At a glance'). Stocke 43.2K est FY24. A actualiser ~44K.

new_kpis.comment: FY25 Net System Sales = EUR 24.474 Mds (+12.4% YoY). Sur 535 unites litho. Mix premium EUV drive valeur unit. KPI HERO canonique semis equipment.
FY25 EUV revenue total = NXE EUR 10.446 Mds (44 units) + EXE 0.55NA EUR 1.157 Mds (4 units). +39% YoY. AI demand structurel. CORE thesis.
Backlog fin 2025 = EUR 38.8 Mds (CEO Fouquet). RPO EUR 46.5 Mds dont 65% reconnu sur 12 mois. KPI visibilite cle - remplace 'Bookings' historique.
FY25 Total = EUR 32.667 Mds (+15.6%). Split: Logic EUR 16.054 Mds (49%) / Memory EUR 8.420 Mds (26%) / Service & Field Options EUR 8.193 Mds (25%). S&FO +26.2% YoY.
FY25 NI = EUR 9.609 Mds (+26.9% YoY). EPS basic EUR 24.73 (FY24: EUR 19.25, +28.5%).
FY25 FCF = EUR 11.0 Mds (+20.9%). OCF EUR 12.658 Mds - capex EUR 1.632 Mds. Return shareholders EUR 8.5 Mds (div + buybacks).
FY25 = 48 EUV units (44 NXE + 4 EXE 0.55NA) vs 44 FY24. EXE 5200B en full spec releve premier client FY25. Volume hardware leading-edge.

notes: ASMLF = ADR de ASML Holding NV (meme societe legale). Donnees identiques au ticker ASML.
